# entrepot_role (Data Source)

Looks up a role (built-in such as `viewer`, `developer`, `maintainer`, `admin`, or custom) by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "entrepot_role" "developer" {
  name = "developer"
}

output "developer_actions" {
  value = data.entrepot_role.developer.actions
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Role name.

### Read-Only

- `actions` (List of String) Actions the role grants (`read`, `write`, `delete`, `admin`).
- `builtin` (Boolean) Whether the role is built in (and cannot be changed).
- `description` (String) Role description.
- `id` (String) Same as `name`.
